title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Day Rate of a Booked Day, 2026-27
content:
**Clause.** On an enrollment of the 2026-27 school year in the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, the booked-day fee is figured for the requested date of the enrollment's most recent drop-in booking request that is received or completed, the latest being taken by the time it was received. The fee is the day rate of the requested date, rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up. The day rate is:

- **the holiday camp day fee** for a date that is one of the district's 2026-27 holiday camp dates, booked as a holiday camp day;
- for a date that is one of its 2026-27 early-release dates, booked as an early-release afternoon: **the early-release day fee** when the plan does not include early-release afternoons, and **no fee** when it does;
- **the drop-in day fee** for any other date, booked as a drop-in day.

**Order.** The schedule's amounts work together in one order. The part that sets the rate charged acts on the day rate first. Every part that adds or takes off a fixed amount is then applied. The total is the fee, rounded once at the end. No fee posts when the day carries no day rate.

The three day fees and whether a plan includes early-release afternoons are shown in the plan figures for drop-in, holiday camp and early-release days.

## District calendar, 2026-27

| Date class | Dates |
|---|---|
| Holiday camp dates | 2026-11-23, 2026-11-24, 2026-11-25, 2026-12-21, 2026-12-22, 2026-12-23, 2026-12-28, 2026-12-29, 2026-12-30, 2027-01-04, 2027-01-18, 2027-02-15, 2027-03-15, 2027-03-16, 2027-03-17, 2027-03-18, 2027-03-19 |
| Early-release dates | 2026-10-09, 2026-12-18, 2027-03-12, 2027-05-27 |

## Day rate by date class

| Requested date | Booked as | Day rate |
|---|---|---|
| on the holiday camp list | holiday camp day | holiday camp day fee |
| on the early-release list, on a plan that includes early-release afternoons | early-release afternoon | none, so no fee posts |
| on the early-release list, on a plan that does not include them | early-release afternoon | early-release day fee |
| any other date | drop-in day | drop-in day fee |

## Worked figures (hypothetical fees: drop-in 20.00, holiday camp 35.00, early release 12.00)

- A request for a date on the holiday camp list gives a fee of 35.00.
- A request for an early-release date on a plan that includes early-release afternoons gives no fee.
- A request for an ordinary school-day date gives 20.00.
- A cancelled request received after a completed one is passed over, and the completed request is the one priced.
